english.title: Make a false statement re DOB, qualification, etc in a candidate nomination document
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of a corrupt practice in that, in the case of a

(A)_[parliamentary]_
(B)_[local government]_

election, you made in a document, in which you gave your consent to your nomination as a candidate, a statement

(C)_[of your date of birth]_
(D)_[as to your qualification for being elected at that election]_
(E)_[that you were not a candidate at an election for another constituency the poll for which was to be held on the same day as the poll at the election to which the consent related]_

which you knew to be false in a particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 65A(1A) and 168(1) of the Representation of the People Act1983.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.

Time Limit for prosecutions:
NoneNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
